author: DerFalscheBorg
body:
Hmm, I do not know about towers for a t9, but for me as a t10 I am drowning in tower keys, as you wrote, I usually get more keys out than I put in. Again, maybe t10 towers spawn the tower guardians more often? I also never use my keys on towers that are below 25/30 floors, because the time investment is not worth the shard rewards for me, so that might come into play as well.
I guess your best bet might be using affinity candles (if you can, hop on a subway train or bus) and hope they will spawn.
BTW, my friends and I had the same experience when doing the boss strategy. Zero guardians during all our tries. So we just stopped, and we will never try this again.

author: weirdplacetogoonfire
body:
Since the tower layouts are the same for a week, I would ask in discord or here midweek which tower has good key payouts. Like I think I got back 5 keys from doing a 45 floor prometheus this week. Especially for a tower with one appearing in the early floors, then you can run it without too much worries since you should get the key back pretty quickly. I'd say the vast majority of my tower runs are either key neutral or positive - so you should be able to get to a point where you won't need to worry about it.

Edit: Sorry, just realized you were t9 and not t10 - I think you'll have to be very careful with asking then, as my assumption is that t10 mob layouts will be completely different from t9, and most tower climbers are probably in the t10 bucket.

author: Loukhi
body:
Turn your view distance to the minimum while somebody else is driving. Pop dowsing rod, occult and affinity candles. Turn off all the buildings so it's easier to see the enemies.

The mobs will all be clustered close and they will reset more frequently. You have a higher likelihood of seeing a guardian this way.

Once you get to where you can go through the towers freely you will see guardians inside the tower quite often, they aren't a guaranteed key drop but they're pretty close.
